framework_history.text: The entity applied the IFRS for SMEs in the prior year; this is not its first set of IFRS for SMEs statements.

decisions.reason: The entity has 25,000 issued ordinary shares (account 83000)
No operation was discontinued in either year; the M-2 sale is an asset disposal within continuing operations
No item of other comprehensive income arose in either year: no revaluation, foreign operation, hedge or actuarial gain or loss
The entity holds no investment in an associate or jointly controlled entity
A dividend of TZS 1,500.00 was declared on 15 August 2025, after the reporting date
The entity is controlled by its sole shareholder and director
The director's loan (account 82500) and its interest (account 86300) are related party transactions

notes.source: Complete SME report: synthetic FY2025 engagement file (case 2)

general.smes.note.policies: Basis of preparation. These financial statements are prepared on the historical cost basis. Inventories are measured at the lower of cost and estimated selling price less costs to complete and sell. Trade receivables are measured at the transaction price less any impairment. The loan from the director is measured at amortised cost. Revenue from the sale of goods is recognised when the goods are delivered to the customer. A gain on the disposal of equipment is the difference between the net proceeds and the carrying amount and is presented in other income. Income tax expense is the current tax on the taxable profit of the year at the enacted rate.
general.smes.note.estimates: The key sources of estimation uncertainty are the useful lives of plant and machinery and of motor vehicles, set out below. No other assumption about the future has a significant risk of causing a material adjustment within the next financial year.
general.smes.note.subclassifications: Trade and other receivables of TZS 6,000.00 (2024: TZS 4,500.00) are all amounts due from customers. Inventories of TZS 3,500.00 (2024: TZS 3,000.00) are finished agricultural supplies held for sale. Trade and other payables of TZS 4,200.00 (2024: TZS 3,800.00) are all amounts due to suppliers. Borrowings of TZS 5,000.00 (2024: TZS 7,000.00) are the loan from the director described in the related party note.

wording.smes.note.compliance: These financial statements have been prepared in accordance with the International Financial Reporting Standard for Small and Medium-sized Entities (IFRS for SMEs), 2015 edition. They report a synthetic entity created to exercise the product.
wording.smes.note.identification: Mwanza Agro Supplies Limited (synthetic) is a private company limited by shares with its registered office in Mwanza, Tanzania; it buys and sells agricultural supplies. These financial statements cover the year ended 30 June 2025, with comparative figures for the year ended 30 June 2024, and are presented in Tanzanian shillings (TZS) to two decimal places.
wording.smes.note.judgements: The directors judged that the sale of the M-2 bottling line was the disposal of a single asset within continuing operations and not a discontinued operation. Apart from this and the estimates described in the estimates note, no judgement had a significant effect on the amounts recognised.
wording.smes.note.share_capital: Share capital of TZS 25,000.00 comprises 25,000 ordinary shares of TZS 1.00 each, authorised, issued and fully paid, unchanged in both years, all held by the director. Each share carries one vote and an equal right to dividends; no share is subject to any restriction. An interim dividend of TZS 1,000.00 was paid on 15 November 2024 (2024: nil).
wording.smes.note.going_concern: The directors assessed the entity's ability to continue as a going concern for at least twelve months from 30 September 2025. Operating activities generated TZS 6,506.00 of cash in the year, cash at 30 June 2025 is TZS 6,338.00 after equipment purchases of TZS 18,250.00, and the director has confirmed in writing that the loan of TZS 5,000.00 will not be called within that period; no material uncertainty was identified.
wording.smes.note.authorisation: These financial statements were authorised for issue by the board of directors on 30 September 2025. The directors have the power to amend them after issue.
wording.smes.note.kmp_compensation: Key management personnel compensation, all short-term employee benefits included in salaries, totalled TZS 2,400.00 (2024: TZS 2,200.00).
wording.smes.note.cash_components: Cash and cash equivalents of TZS 6,338.00 (2024: TZS 16,040.00) comprise the balance on the main operating bank account (account 81000). There are no overdrafts, restricted balances or other cash equivalents.
wording.smes.note.income_tax: Tax expense of TZS 1,200.00 (2024: TZS 800.00) is current income tax assessed on the taxable profit of the year under the synthetic scenario's tax rules; the difference from the profit before tax of TZS 4,400.00 (2024: TZS 2,050.00) at the enacted rate arises from non-deductible expenses. No deferred tax arises because the carrying amounts of assets and liabilities equal their tax bases. Income tax payable at 30 June 2025 is TZS 1,200.00 (2024: TZS 800.00).
wording.smes.note.revenue: Revenue of TZS 48,000.00 (2024: TZS 40,000.00) arises entirely from the sale of agricultural supplies and is recognised when the goods are delivered to the customer. Other income of TZS 300.00 (2024: TZS 50.00) is the gain on the sale of the M-2 bottling line (2024: a fully depreciated tool).
wording.smes.note.events_after: On 15 August 2025 the directors declared a dividend of TZS 1,500.00 (TZS 0.06 per share), payable on 30 October 2025. The dividend was declared after the reporting date and is not recognised as a liability at 30 June 2025. No other event after the reporting date requires adjustment or disclosure.
wording.smes.note.related_party_control: The entity is controlled by its sole shareholder and director, who holds all 25,000 ordinary shares. There is no parent entity.
wording.smes.note.related_party_transactions: Loan from the director: the balance at 30 June 2025 is TZS 5,000.00 (2024: TZS 7,000.00) after a repayment of TZS 2,000.00 on 15 June 2025 (2024: TZS 1,000.00). The loan is unsecured and repayable at the entity's discretion; interest of TZS 600.00 (2024: TZS 700.00) was charged under the loan agreement and paid in the year. No amount due to the director was written off, and no guarantee was given or received. The director's compensation is disclosed in the key management personnel note.
